name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' is correctly a hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) — the fall is a one-step event and holding_box on the very next step is exactly the pickup the task demands ('very next move' rules out a plain Response). 'If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box' is correctly a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) alone: reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if', so no Existence(at_exit) is added, and since at_exit holds only on the last step the Response reduces to carrying the box on the exit step, matching the wording. Both clauses are hard (no preference cue), all propositions are declared, nothing is added or missing, and the rule-only warning is valid because the task consists solely of conditional rules with no unconditionally commanded goal.

texts: Each time the box falls, the agent must be holding it again on the very next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, it must be carrying the box at that moment.
